name: Review Slider for WooCommerce
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Display WooCommerce Product Reviews Anywhere

Review Slider for WooCommerce lets you display WooCommerce product reviews in a beautiful review slider, review carousel, review grid, or list anywhere on your WordPress website.

Import your existing WooCommerce customer reviews, store them locally in your WordPress database, and display them with fast-loading templates using a shortcode or widget. Once your reviews have been synced, they are served directly from your own website for excellent performance without relying on external API requests.

Whether you want to build trust on your homepage, highlight recent customer feedback on product pages, or increase conversions with social proof throughout your WooCommerce store, Review Slider for WooCommerce makes it simple.

Features

  • Display WooCommerce product reviews in a slider, carousel, grid, or list.
  • Sync existing WooCommerce customer reviews into the plugin.
  • Store reviews locally in your WordPress database for fast loading.
  • Automatically sync newly approved WooCommerce reviews.
  • Display product images alongside each review.
  • Link reviews back to the original WooCommerce product.
  • Show all reviews or only reviews for the current product.
  • Mobile-friendly responsive review slider.
  • Add review sliders anywhere using shortcodes or widgets.
  • Create unlimited review templates.
  • Customize colors, borders, star ratings, dates, and custom CSS.
  • Display only reviews that include review text.
  • Sort reviews randomly or by newest.
  • Lightweight plugin designed for speed.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce stores
  • Product review sliders
  • Customer review carousels
  • Testimonial sliders
  • Homepage social proof
  • Landing pages
  • Product pages
  • Shop pages
  • WooCommerce review widgets

Why Store Reviews Locally?

Unlike plugins that request reviews from external services every time a page loads, Review Slider for WooCommerce stores synced reviews inside your own WordPress database.

Benefits include:

  • Faster page loading
  • Better compatibility with page caching
  • No external API requests
  • Complete control over your reviews
  • Reliable performance

I personally support all of my plugins and appreciate every customer. If you have questions or suggestions, I’d love to hear from you.

Upgrade to Pro

The Pro version lets you display reviews from Google, Facebook, Yelp, TripAdvisor, Airbnb, Thumbtack, and more than 85 review platforms.

Pro features include:

  • Import reviews from 85+ review sites.
  • More than 10 review slider and review widget templates.
  • Floating review badges and pop-ins.
  • Advanced slider controls including autoplay, arrows, dots, animation, and height options.
  • Filter reviews by rating, date, keywords, or manually hide reviews.
  • Add manual reviews.
  • Export reviews to CSV.
  • Google Review Schema markup.
  • Priority support.
  • Lifetime access to future Pro features.

Learn more:
https://wpreviewslider.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the review-slider-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Review Slider in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Visit Sync Reviews and import your WooCommerce reviews.
  5. Verify imported reviews under Review List.
  6. Create a review template.
  7. Copy the shortcode and place it anywhere on your website.
sections.faq:
Are reviews stored on my server?

Yes. WooCommerce reviews are copied into your WordPress database during sync. Your website serves those reviews locally for fast performance.

Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated because this plugin displays WooCommerce product reviews.

Can I display reviews anywhere?

Yes. Use the included shortcode or widget to display your review slider on any page, post, widget area, or homepage.

Can I display reviews for only one product?

Yes. Enable the post filter when using a template on a WooCommerce product page to display only that product’s reviews.

Can I create multiple review sliders?

Yes. Create unlimited templates with different layouts and settings.

Is the review slider responsive?

Yes. Every review template is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does this work with my WooCommerce theme?

Yes. The plugin works with virtually all WooCommerce-compatible WordPress themes.

How do I request a feature?

Post on the support forum or contact us through our website.
